rows.implementation: The hook records the runner (runner_name, a row of the binary's own list) and the stage of the pipe that hid its exit status (masked_by); the post reads a gate run's output, at most 1 MiB, in memory, classifies it with gateout's tables keyed by the runner's table word and writes gate_output. From call schema 8 (schema 9 adds location_unread) and rules version 11, a masked run whose every later stage is tail without -c, tee or a bare cat, that ended ok and was not backgrounded, takes its outcome from the runner's own summary line: summary_pass is green (not for make, npm, yarn or pnpm, whose output holds every step's lines: their pass stays masked), summary_fail is red, empty_run is absent, each carrying outcome_from output_summary into the steer line and the Stop line, which names the runner and says it was read from its output. A bare fail line decides only for a runner whose table has no summary form (none now). Every other masked run is never green: a run behind head, grep, wc, sort, cut or an unlisted stage, an output with no summary line, a runner no table names, an older record, and a status hidden by something that is not a pipe (|| true, ; echo $?) stay in the masked_inconclusive state. pytest's pass is anchored to its summary line, a crash (Fatal Python error, Killed) is red, the delegate runners' own failure markers (make ***, npm ERR!, yarn error Command failed, ERR_PNPM) are red, and a gate word for a runner no table names stays the line's first word.
missing: the pass read from the last summary line under the pipeline commands that drop it (head, grep, wc, sort, cut) and under any stage no list names: only tail, tee and cat read the summary, and the rest stay masked_inconclusive (VER-6 to VER-10)
